summary: Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years in production web and mobile applications, specialized in TypeScript, React, and Next.js. Before engineering, spent 5 years as an Art Director — which bridges design, marketing, user experience, and code in ways most engineers can't. Published researcher in multi-criteria navigation; undergraduate thesis in cross silo federated learning.

tasks: Built an internal content management system for authorities' information, calendar management, and news publishing for internal and external audiences using Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, and the Unio Design System.
Built Unio Design System in React and TypeScript with polymorphic APIs and Storybook, reducing developer onboarding time through self-service component discovery.
Migrated the public portal from Lumis CMS to Next.js and Strapi, decoupling content publishing from the frontend and improving LCP and TTFB via SSR and static generation.
Built a reusable GitHub Projects automation adopted across the team, consolidating four separate per-discipline projects into one shared workflow for company-wide visibility.
Automated project card transitions based on pull request state and environment labels using GitHub App-authenticated Actions workflows, reducing manual status updates.
Developed TCU Digital, a Microsoft Teams tab app dashboard that replaced the SharePoint-based dashboard and supports customizable per-user grids without code changes.
Migrated 20+ CI/CD pipelines from Jenkins to GitHub Actions, standardizing reusable workflows and reducing execution time by 20–30%.

Designed the Module Federation microfrontend architecture for the Inspections portal in Trimble Fleet Manager, enabling autonomous CI/CD and independent PR workflows and becoming the internal standard for new product onboarding.
Shipped the Trimble Inspections MVP to production, taking features from concept through phased rollout for major North American commercial fleets.
Contributed to the Trimble Inspections mobile app in Kotlin as part of the Trimble Instinct platform, supporting production launches for major North American fleets.
Built backend services with Node.js cloud functions and Firebase Firestore for production data storage in the Inspections feature.
Delivered two internal Tech Talks on microfrontend architecture for the global engineering organization.
Built automated test suites across unit, integration, and E2E layers with Vitest and Playwright and integrated Datadog and Sentry for production observability.
Mentored interns and migrated legacy C# ELD modules to React and TypeScript, reducing codebase complexity across frontend and backend.

tasks.item: Developed a federated learning method for cross-silo training where institutions hold datasets with partially overlapping variables in Python, TensorFlow, and Flower.
Designed two route-planning algorithms that factor in crime rates and road conditions alongside travel time for multi-criteria navigation systems.
